system_metadata.author: Dan Olsen
system_metadata.grounding_source: The Lean Product Playbook: How to Innovate with Minimum Viable Products and Rapid Customer Feedback (2015)

space_pen_mirage.analogy: Paul Fisher spending $1 million inventing the Space Pen while Russian astronauts used pencils.
space_pen_mirage.risk: Jumping into solution space before defining the core problem.
space_pen_mirage.action: Separate What (problem space) from How (solution space) before design begins.

follow_me_home.analogy: Intuit employees following Quicken buyers home to watch install and first use.
follow_me_home.action: Prioritize direct behavioral observation over polite survey comments.

oprah_versus_spock.action: Use Oprah to validate product-market fit on paper; use Spock to optimize metrics after launch.

silver_bullet_metric.analogy: Friendster's address-book importer doubling invites per sender in one week.
silver_bullet_metric.action: Find low-effort, high-upside levers with compound growth.

local_maximum_hill.analogy: Optimizing a landing page to a local peak while missing a global maximum that needs a pivot.
local_maximum_hill.action: When iterative tests flatten, zoom out to target customer or value proposition.

olsen_hierarchy_of_web_needs.5_ux_design: How easy and enjoyable the product is to use.
olsen_hierarchy_of_web_needs.4_feature_set: Functionality that meets a customer need.
olsen_hierarchy_of_web_needs.3_absence_of_bugs: Quality — does it work as supposed to?

must_haves.definition: Table stakes; absence causes extreme dissatisfaction.

performance_features.definition: More is better; satisfaction scales with fulfillment.
performance_features.example: Fuel efficiency or page load speed.

delighters.definition: Unexpected wow; absence does not dissatisfy.

kano_model_categories.migration_rule: Yesterday's delighters become today's performance features and tomorrow's must-haves.

sean_ellis_pmf.question: How would you feel if you could no longer use [product]?
